# Requirements and Traceability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements themselves (domains 1 Requirements and 16 Traceability of the SDD guide's checklist prompt)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` = constitutional or assignment obligation; `[Enhancement]` = optional improvement. `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are functional requirements defined for every area the guide names: creation, invalid-URL rejection, code uniqueness, redirect, expiry, analytics, idempotency, concurrency, persistence failure, health, workflow creation and inspection, approval and rejection, retries and timeouts, rollback or compensation, safe-stop, resumption, replanning, audit inspection, and release readiness? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Does every NFR area (security, reliability, scalability, maintainability, observability, auditability, performance, recoverability, testability, change safety, controlled autonomy) have at least one requirement with a stated verification method? [Completeness, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is every numeric target without a client source recorded as a Proposed Validation Target instead of a confirmed requirement? [Clarity, Spec §Proposed Validation Targets, Constitution I] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is each FR's provenance (confirmed from assignment, guide, or constitution vs. derived) visible on the requirement itself? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements provenance tags] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Are exclusions stated for capabilities commonly expected of URL shorteners but out of scope (accounts, custom domains, QR codes, reputation scanning, rollout percentages)? [Completeness, Spec §Exclusions] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Does each `[Derived]` requirement name the parent requirement or principle that justifies it? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all bounded behaviors (retries, deadlines, limits, windows, budgets, clarification rounds) quantified by a PVT reference instead of adjectives? [Clarity, Spec §FR-REL-01, §FR-GOV-07, §FR-ORC-18, §FR-REL-06] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "material change" defined identically wherever it gates an approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-ORC-06, §FR-RPL-03, Plan §3 design materiality] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between the expired and not-found outcomes specified, including for click-exhausted links? [Clarity, Spec §FR-RED-03, §FR-RED-04, §SCN-B AC-2] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Is the fail-open analytics rule reconciled with the fail-closed rule for click-limited links without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-ANL-04, §SCN-B AC-6] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Do the link authentication rules agree with the US1 actor description and assumptions ASM-02/ASM-03? [Consistency, Spec §FR-LNK-13, §Clarifications Q2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the provisional clarification answers Q1–Q5 reflected identically in the FRs, assumptions, and ambiguity register? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications] [Mandatory]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Does every user story include at least one negative acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Spec §US1–US7] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Can every success criterion SC-001..SC-009 be evaluated as a count, a rate, or a yes/no observation? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria] [Mandatory]

## Ambiguities and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK015 Is every assumption ASM-01..ASM-11 tied to an owner and a decision point? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, §Ambiguity Register] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the deferred questions (AMB-04, AMB-07, AMB-08, AMB-09, AMB-11) recorded with current assumptions rather than silently resolved? [Ambiguity, Spec §Ambiguity Register] [Mandatory]

## Traceability

- [ ] CHK017 Is a stable identifier scheme defined for requirements, scenarios, drills, assumptions, targets, and evidence items? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability Notes] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the plan define the chain Requirement → Scenario → Design → ADR → Task → Code → Test → Validation → Documentation → Evidence, including where each link is recorded? [Traceability, Plan §13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Is an executable mechanism defined that fails when an FR or SCN has no test? [Traceability, Plan §13, Spec §SC-003] Detects: orphan requirements. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK020 Is a mechanism defined that detects tests citing no requirement and tasks citing no requirement? [Gap, Plan §13] Detects: orphan tests, orphan tasks. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK021 Does each task have to name the code paths it creates, so that code without a task can be identified? [Gap, Plan §13] Detects: orphan implementation. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK022 Does every ADR cite the requirement identifiers and plan sections it serves? [Traceability, docs/adr] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it specified how scenario acceptance criteria (GF-001, BF-001, AMB-001) map to the probes that verify them? [Traceability, Spec §FR-ORC-16, Plan §11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements linked to the evidence items (E-A*, E-B*, SCN-C list) that prove them? [Traceability, Spec §Required Scenarios] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it defined how the committed traceability matrix stays synchronized with the tests (regeneration command, convergence step)? [Consistency, Plan §13] [Enhancement]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
